title: We sell jobs booked, not “brand impressions.”
lede: Most trades agencies hide behind reach metrics because they can’t tie spend to revenue. We start the other way around: pick the number that pays the bills, then work back.
ctaLabel: See how it would work for you

items.head: Lock the metric before the contract.
items.body: Cost-per-booked-job is the only KPI on our dashboards. Everything else is diagnostic.

items.head: Instrument before we optimize.
items.body: Call tracking, form attribution, CRM sync — in place month one, or we don’t turn on ads.

items.head: Quarterly cleanup, no contract lock-in.
items.body: Month-to-month after the first 90 days. If the number isn’t moving, you walk — we keep the tracking we built.
